demos.name: BasicFunnel
demos.description: The demo below shows a simple funnel with four decreasing values.

demos.name: FunnelLegend
demos.description: Set hideLegend to true to hide the legend.

demos.name: PyramidFunnel
demos.description: Set the curve property to 'pyramid' on the series.

demos.name: FunnelLabels
demos.description: The funnel shows labels by default (each section's value).

demos.name: FunnelLabelStyling
demos.description: Use the funnelSectionClasses.label class to style labels.

demos.name: FunnelLabelPositioning
demos.description: Set sectionLabel to false to hide labels.

demos.name: FunnelCurves
demos.description: Use the curve property to choose the shape between sections.

demos.name: FunnelGap
demos.description: Use the gap property to set the space between sections (in pixels).

demos.name: FunnelBorderRadius
demos.description: If gap is 0, radius applies only to corners not connected to another section.

demos.name: FunnelVariant
demos.description: The outlined variant is lighter visually.

demos.name: FunnelColor
FunnelDataAttributes
demos.description: You can style the funnel with CSS.

demos.name: FunnelStacked
demos.description: By default, multiple series are stacked.

demos.name: HighlightFunnel
demos.description: Set highlightScope.highlight to 'item' to highlight the hovered section.

demos.name: FunnelCategoryAxis
demos.description: To show it, pass position and categories to the categoryAxis prop.

demos.name: FunnelLinearScale
demos.description: By default, sections use the band scale (equal width).

demos.name: FunnelAxisAutoSize
demos.description: You can set the axis size to 'auto' to automatically calculate the axis dimension based on tick label measurements.
